title: Churchill Capital Corp IX/Cayman 8-K Filing — Termination of Merger Agreement
summary: Churchill Capital Corp IX, a SPAC listed on Nasdaq (ticker CCIXU), terminated its merger agreement with PlusAI (Plus Automation, Inc.) effective April 20, 2026, citing market conditions as the reason. The company cancelled its previously scheduled shareholder meeting and redemption deadline.
key_points: Merger Agreement between Churchill Capital Corp IX and PlusAI was terminated by mutual consent on April 20, 2026
Termination cited as being 'due to market conditions'
Extraordinary general meeting scheduled for April 24, 2026 was cancelled

SPAC units consist of one Class A ordinary share and one-quarter of one redeemable warrant (ticker CCIXU)
Warrants are exercisable at $11.50 per share (ticker CCIXW)
